svg.title: How Second Brain OS works
svg.desc: Claude Code and Codex sessions sit above a dashed line; below it there is no model, only plain files, Node and Git. Both runtimes run the same SessionStart hook and share one set of rules (AGENTS.md) and one skills folder (.agents/skills). At session start the hook pulls the vault and injects core/: IDENTITY, USER and MEMORY. On demand the session reads INDEX.md and then the two or three notes it names (tier 1); logs are searched last (tier 2); raw/ holds the sources you saved, which /ingest distills into notes. A skill such as /lesson, /file or /closeout writes a note or a log, and the task commits exactly the paths it wrote. Git is the only database, and the hook never commits.

g.text: Two runtimes, one hook, one vault — and Git underneath
Session start: the hook pulls, then injects core/
A question: INDEX.md first, then two or three pages
The task commits exactly the paths it wrote
